summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 1, 2026 press release announcing an expansion of its long-standing antibody alliance with Regeneron, not a change-of-control event. Regeneron receives a $1 billion upfront payment, with up to $7 billion in additional development, regulatory and commercial milestones; the companies will co-develop and co-commercialize four long-acting antibodies targeting IL-13, IL-4xIL-13, IL-4 and IL-4R alpha, sharing costs and global profits 50:50. REGN20423 is in phase 1 for atopic dermatitis; three others enter clinic in 2027. Dupixent economics are unchanged. Watch milestone timing and clinical readouts.
